title: The Async Multiprocessing Has Sound Foundations in Linux, But Further Testing Is Needed
gist: At Embedded Linux Conference Europe 2026, Linux I2C maintainer Wolfram Sang assessed the kernel's asymmetric multiprocessing building blocks (mailbox, remoteproc, RPMsg, virtio, hwspinlock) as sound but thinly staffed and inconsistently tested.

themes.theme: Health of the Linux AMP stack

insights.claim: Wolfram Sang concluded Linux's asymmetric multiprocessing building blocks are sound enough to build on but need more reviewers and testers; he did not say they were broken.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Embedded vendors building heterogeneous SoCs depend on thinly maintained upstream code, a maintenance risk.

insights.claim: Remoteproc core commits grew from 175 at Linux 5.0 to roughly 1,550, though growth slowed after an earlier surge.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Activity has plateaued after a surge, pointing to mature but maintained code.

insights.claim: Mailbox subsystem commits and drivers grew recently, but only about four authors have contributed more than five patches.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Concentration of contributors is a key-person risk.

insights.claim: Hardware spinlock core commits rose only from 19 to 30 over roughly seven years while the driver count stayed flat.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Hwspinlock is a stagnant corner of the stack.

insights.claim: A basic AMP system runs Linux application CPUs and a smaller real-time core on one SoC, using a mailbox for signalling and shared SRAM or DDR for data.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Mental model for heterogeneous-core embedded designs.

insights.claim: Because doorbells are unidirectional, a bidirectional SCMI channel can require four mailboxes, and existing firmware on the Keystone platform left no acknowledgement path for notifications.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Firmware choices constrain Linux driver design, adding integration cost.

insights.claim: The proposed virtio-over-message transport, which would carry virtio traffic over a message channel, is not yet upstream.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Standardised inter-processor virtio is still pending.
insights.locator: Virtio defines an open communication standard

insights.claim: Testing AMP drivers can require modified firmware and U-Boot, and OpenAMP examples do not yet run uniformly across supported boards.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Test friction suppresses contributions, slowing AMP adoption in more ambitious systems.
insights.quote: reducing that friction is key to sustaining the more ambitious AMP systems
